_comment: Step 9: every string a user reads, in English (the fallback for every other language). Keys must exist in en; other languages may only use keys that exist here (worker/test/i18n.test.mjs lists missing and extra keys). {name} style placeholders are filled by code. Plural forms: en/fr/hy one+other, ru one+few+many. Never an em or en dash.

digest.quiet: {hello}. Quiet period: nothing important on your topics {since}.

bot.welcome_times: I send you a short digest of the most important news at {times} ({zone}).
bot.welcome_next: Your next digest comes {when}. Tap {button} to change topics, times, language and more.
bot.help_new: Hi! Send /start and I will send you short news digests three times a day.
bot.help_paused: Your digests are paused. Send /start to turn them back on.
bot.help: I send news digests at {times} ({zone}). Your next one comes {when}. Send /settings to change them. I can't answer questions; the digest is all I do.
bot.settings: Choose your topics, language and when your digests arrive. Changes are saved as soon as you make them.

errors.reopen: Please close and reopen the settings from the bot.
errors.reopen_simple: Please close and reopen the settings.
errors.keep_time: Keep at least one digest time.
errors.max_times: You can have up to {max} digest times.
errors.times_hour: Times must be on the hour, between {from} and {to}.
errors.pause_bool: Pause must be on or off.
errors.server: Something went wrong. Please try again in a minute.
errors.owner_only: This is only for the bot's owner.

app.title: Settings
app.hero_paused_sub: Turn off Pause at the bottom to start again.
app.times_hint: Tap a time to add or remove it, up to {max}.
app.topics_foot: Your digest covers the topics you turn on.
app.zone_foot: Digest times follow your phone's time zone. It updates each time you open this.
app.pause_foot: While paused you get no digests. Your settings are kept.
app.language_foot: Digests, bot messages and these settings appear in this language. A digest with stories that are not translated yet comes in English.
app.fine: Changes are saved as soon as you make them.
app.keep_time: Keep at least one digest time
app.max_times: Up to {max} times a day. Remove one first.
app.no_connection: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
app.generic_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
app.open_in_telegram: These settings open from the Axiom News bot. Send /settings to the bot and tap Open settings.
